question: Does Dual-Stream Attentive Readout (DSAR) combined with Noisy Nodes auxiliary regularization and Pair Update LayerNorm surpass the project record (0.147245 eV) and baseline (0.156627 eV) under the frozen 100K contract?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: Standard GPTrans-T discards all 7,680 dimensions of real atomic representations produced across 12 layers, relying solely on a single 256-dim virtual node. DSAR adaptively pools real atomic features alongside the virtual token, while Noisy Nodes prevents representation collapse on atom representations.
alternative_explanations: Auxiliary noisy nodes training interferes with attentive pooling weights
Over-regularization prevents optimal attentive pooling convergence
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: Joint combination of Noisy Nodes auxiliary denoising loss (alpha=0.1, std=0.15), Pair Update LayerNorm, and Dual-Stream Attentive Readout (544-dim head)
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: 60-epoch 100K/50K run failing to achieve 0.003 eV gain over the 0.156627 eV baseline (threshold < 0.153627 eV)
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: nominate DSAR + Noisy Nodes + Pair Norm as champion architecture for 500K scale-up
